newsitem.title: USA: UPS FY96 revenues, net and share rise.
newsitem.headline: UPS FY96 revenues, net and share rise.

text.p: United Parcel Service of America Inc on Friday reported 1996 revenues of $22.37 billion and net income of $1.15 billion, or $2.01 per share.

In 1995 revenues were $21.05 billion and net income was $1.04 billion, or $1.83 per share. The 1995 results included a $372 million pre-tax restructuring charge for a voluntary early retirement and severance program primarily affecting management, the company said.
The package delivery company has about 336,000 employees, total assets of more than $14.95 billion, total shareowner equity in excess of $5.9 billion and 570 million outstanding shares.
